title: GEOMAPS: sparse-pyramid MVT and MLT compression — software
description: Code for “Does Tile Granularity Matter? An Empirical Study of Vector Tile Compression for Map Rendering with MapLibre Tiles”. Vector-source normalization, paired Standard/Dense-4/Dense-16 MVT and MLT PMTiles conversion, independent decoded-pair diagnostics, compression statistics, map figures, and SQLite/Parquet/CSV dataset export. Accompanying dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23452598.

creators.name: Nefedov, Viacheslav
creators.affiliation: Holon Institute of Technology, Ariel University
